SELECT p.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN '삭제된 게시물' WHEN pt.name = '공지' THEN '공지' WHEN pt.name = '자유' THEN '자유' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집중)' THEN '모집중' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집완료)' THEN '모집완료' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(미해결)' THEN '미해결' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(해결)' THEN '해결' ELSE pt.name END as postType, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN '[삭제된 게시물]' ELSE p.title END as postTitle, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN CONCAT('삭제 사유: ', COALESCE(p.delete_reason, '사유 없음')) ELSE CAST(p.content AS CHAR) END as postContent, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.delete_reason, '사유 없음') ELSE NULL END as deleteReason, u.nickname as writerNickname, p.write_date as writeDate, p.view as postView, p.like_num as postLikeNum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.recomment_check = 0 AND c.delete_check = 0) as postCommNum FROM post p JOIN post_type pt ON p.post_type = pt.no JOIN user u ON p.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1 -- 일반 사용자에게는 삭제된 게시물 숨김 AND (p.delete_check = 0 OR p.delete_check IS NULL)
AND p.post_type IN
#{type}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND CAST(p.content AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{writer}, '%')
ORDER BY p.write_date DESC
ORDER BY p.view DESC
ORDER BY p.like_num DESC
ORDER BY postCommNum DESC
ORDER BY p.write_date DESC
LIMIT #{pageStart}, #{pageSize}

SELECT p.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN '삭제된 게시물' WHEN pt.name = '공지' THEN '공지' WHEN pt.name = '자유' THEN '자유' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집중)' THEN '모집중' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집완료)' THEN '모집완료' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(미해결)' THEN '미해결' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(해결)' THEN '해결' ELSE pt.name END as postType, pt.name as postTypeName, u.nickname as writerNickname, p.writer_id, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN '[삭제된 게시물]' ELSE p.title END as postTitle, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN CONCAT('이 게시물은 삭제되었습니다.\n\n삭제 사유: ', COALESCE(p.delete_reason, '사유 없음')) ELSE CAST(p.content AS CHAR) END as postContent, CASE WHEN p.delete_check = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.delete_reason, '사유 없음') ELSE NULL END as deleteReason, p.write_date as writeDate, p.view as postView, p.like_num as postLikeNum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.recomment_check = 0 AND c.delete_check = 0) as postCommNum FROM post p JOIN post_type pt ON p.post_type = pt.no JOIN user u ON p.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
